enumeration_note: One VWAP-band-breakout skeleton (trend-aligned, bidirectional). The video first teaches a bare band-breakout entry (2:1, swing stop) then a filtered refinement adding EMA-trend candle color + Point-of-Control-within-bands confirmation (1.5:1). These differ only in confirmation mechanic and target-R â€” compatible variation, enumerated as one strategy with two variants.

coaching_notes: Traders usually try to avoid consolidating markets; whenever the market is moving sideways or in a consolidation phase the price moves between the VWAP bands.
Even though the VWAP indicator is very useful and powerful there are a lot of false signals with this strategy â€” the added indicators are to filter out fakeouts versus real breakouts.
element_inventory: Long entry: price breaks out above the upper VWAP band
Short entry: price breaks/closes below the lower VWAP band
Long precondition (refined): CM EMA Trend Bars candle is green (uptrend, EMA up trend set to 200)
Short precondition (refined): CM EMA Trend Bars candle is red (downtrend)
Confirmation filter (refined): Point of Control line must be within the VWAP bands at the breakout
Long stop: recent swing low (place slightly below VWAP if swing low is close to the VWAP line)
Short stop: recent swing high (place just above VWAP if swing high is nearby)
Indicator config: Volume Profile Fixed Range row size 36, number of bars 300
Indicator config: CM EMA Trend Bars EMA up trend value 200
strategies.entry_summary: Enter on a VWAP band breakout: long when price breaks above the upper VWAP band, short when price breaks/closes below the lower VWAP band. The refined variant additionally requires trend alignment (CM EMA Trend Bars green for longs / red for shorts) and the Volume Profile Point of Control sitting within the VWAP bands at the moment of breakout.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop at the recent swing low (long) or recent swing high (short) â€” or slightly beyond the VWAP line when the swing is near it. Target a fixed risk-to-reward ratio (2:1 in the basic variant, 1.5:1 in the refined filtered variant).
strategies.name: vwap_band_breakout_trend_aligned

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: No filter â€” enter purely on price breaking above the upper VWAP band (long) or below the lower VWAP band (short)
variants.transcript_quote: We will enter into a buy position whenever the price breaks out above the upper V-wap band. We will be placing the stoploss at the recent swing low and for the take profit we will target a 2 times risk-to-reward ratio.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Requires trend-aligned candle color (CM EMA Trend Bars EMA 200: green=uptrend for long / red=downtrend for short) AND Point of Control within the VWAP bands at breakout
variants.transcript_quote: Firstly the candlestick will need to be green. This shows us that we are currently in an uptrend. Secondly, the price must break above the upper V-wap band. ... Thirdly, the Point of control must be within the V-wap bands when the price breaks out above the upper V-wap band. When all of these conditions have been met we will enter into a buy position.
variants.variant_label: Filtered VWAP band breakout with EMA trend + Point of Control, 1.5:1 target
